name: CHIKAMINE
area: Shibuya 3-chome (渋谷区渋谷3-13-7 五常ビル B1F)
closed: Sundays and Mondays. CLOSED Mon 26 Oct. Open Tue 27, Wed 28, Thu 29 (Fri 30 is dinner-only, no lunch).
hours: Two dinner seatings, 17:00 and 20:30. No lunch listed. Daily hours not otherwise shown.
reservations: Yes, online only. Owner announces openings on Instagram; phone line closed. Cancellation policy unverified.
solo_ok: Yes: Tabelog tags it 'Solo dining friendly'
notes: Opened 6 Dec 2022. Card OK (VISA/JCB/AMEX), service charge added. Non-smoking. Michelin: not found. Booking depends on Instagram release timing, so check now for 27-29 Oct.

name: Tempura Kitagawa
station: Ebisu Sta. (4 min from JR west exit / Hibiya Line exit 1)
awards: Tabelog page shows 'Michelin Guide Tokyo 2026 selected restaurant'. No Tabelog Award or 百名店 badge shown.
closed: Sunday only. Open on all our dinner dates (Mon 26-Thu 29).
reservations: Reservation only. Online (Tabelog) or official LINE @tempura_kitagawa; phone line marked closed. Phones listed: 050-5456-0912, 080-3000-7735.
notes: Not the Ginza Kitagawa (北川, kappo 4.36), a different shop. Dress code: no very casual clothes or strong scent. All cards, e-money and QR accepted. One of the few top tempura counters open on Monday.

name: Sushi Yuu Tsubasa
closed: Tuesday and Wednesday. CLOSED Tue 27 and Wed 28. Open Mon 26 and Thu 29. No weekday lunch, so not Fri 30 lunch.
hours: Mon/Thu/Fri dinner 17:30-19:30 and 20:00-22:00 (two seatings). Sat/Sun/holidays add lunch 12:00-14:00.
reservations: Online (Tabelog); phone line closed. Rules: no perfume, no waiting area, arrive on time, 2-hour session.
solo_ok: Yes: course listed for 1-12 people. On 24 Oct the page showed '1 seat on the 26th at 8 PM' (month not stated; probably Mon 26 Oct).
notes: The best-value omakase counter found here that takes a solo booking. Cards OK, no service charge. Michelin: not found.

name: Sushi Kuriyagawa
station: Ebisu Sta. (8 min from JR east exit)
awards: none shown on detail page (the list page put a Sushi 100 2025 banner near it; not confirmed, so treat as none)
closed: Monday and Sunday. CLOSED Mon 26. Open Tue 27 (dinner only), Wed 28, Thu 29, Fri 30 (lunch and dinner).
reservations: Online via Tabelog; phone line closed. Bookings through Auto Reserve are cancelled. Cancellation fee 100% same day or day before, 50% two days before.
price_dinner: JPY 20,000-29,999 (reviews: 30,000-39,999); the page doesn't say which band is dinner, so the split is inferred
notes: Also a Friday-lunch sushi option. Cannot accommodate alcohol, wheat or soy allergies. Reserve alternative: Sushi Ikki 鮨 一喜, 3.73 (117 reviews), Shibuya 8 min, tagged 'Solo dining friendly', open daily per listed hours, dinner course JPY 24,000 (until Oct), lunch JPY 14,000; https://tabelog.com/en/tokyo/A1303/A130301/13307034/

name: Eiki
awards: Tabelog Award Bronze 2021, 2022, 2025, 2026; Yakitori 百名店 2021, 2022, EAST 2023, 2024, 2025
closed: Sunday, plus 'two additional days' (not named). Open on our dinner dates per the regular pattern.
hours: Mon 19:00-23:00 (conflicts with the page note of 18:00-23:00); Tue-Sat 18:00-23:00. Dinner only.
counter: counter (count not shown); no private room
reservations: Online via 食オク (Shokuoku) per Tabelog; no new phone reservations. Very hard to get.
notes: Stretch pick: elite score, but booking runs through an auction-style site. Trusted-foodie trace: on The Hungry Tourist yakitori 'level list' (tour pages 2026-27), per docs/research/food/18-critics-brazil-deep.md. Cards OK.

name: Kirin
station: Ebisu Sta. (1 min from west exit)
closed: No regular closing day shown (maintenance closure Wed 11 Nov only). Open all our dates.
counter: counter (count not shown); private room for 3-4
reservations: Online (Tabelog); phone line closed. Omakase courses limited to 2 h when busy. Mizutaki course needs 2-4 people (so not for solo).
solo_ok: unverified for booking; à la carte yakitori at the counter suits one
notes: The safe Monday yakitori. 5% service charge plus JPY 500 otoshi. Cards OK. Reserve alternatives: Hagakure 葉隠 (tripe/kushiyaki), 3.64 (416 reviews), Mon-Fri 17:00-23:00, booking needed only for 3+ people, cash, JPY 4-6k, https://tabelog.com/en/tokyo/A1303/A130301/13012940/ ; and 鳥福 (listed as 'Nonbei'), 3.62 (194), 13 counter seats near the Hachiko exit, Mon-Fri 16:00-21:00, cash only, https://tabelog.com/en/tokyo/A1303/A130301/13002121/

name: Shibuya Morimoto
genre: Yakitori (old-school counter, since 1948 per repo research)
closed: Sunday and public holidays. Open Mon 26-Thu 29.
counter: counter seating (count not shown); no private room
solo_ok: walk-in counter; solo policy not stated
notes: Just under the 3.60 bar, kept for its trusted-foodie trace: Mark Wiens filmed it ('chicken sashimi was actually incredible'), video 16 Aug 2017 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iszTT9U4OA8 (per docs/research/food/11 and 13). Cash only. A good fallback for a Monday walk-in.

name: Sumibi Yaki Yuji
area: Udagawa-cho (宇田川町11-1 松沼ビル 1F)
awards: Tabelog Award Bronze 2020-2026, Silver 2019 (Silver 2018 shown only in the JP section); Yakiniku 百名店 2019-2026 (2018 JP section)
closed: Sunday and public holidays. Open Mon 26-Thu 29.
counter: 1F counter plus tables and outdoor entrance tables; no private room
reservations: Online; phone line closed (phone 03-3464-6448 listed for inquiries after 15:00). Reservations need at least 2 people.
solo_ok: Booking NO (2-person minimum). Solo means walk-in for a counter seat; arrive near 16:00 opening. Walk-in success unverified.
notes: The yakiniku pick with the strongest awards in the area, and the most plausible solo option among the elite yakiniku places (Yoroniku 4.25 not checked for solo). No cards, e-money or QR, so bring cash.

name: Koutarou
awards: Tabelog Award Bronze 2017-2020; Izakaya 百名店 2021, 2022, EAST 2024, 2025, 2026
closed: Monday plus 1st and 3rd Tuesday. CLOSED Mon 26. Tue 27 Oct is the 4th Tuesday, so open. Open Wed 28, Thu 29.
reservations: Online (phone line closed). Bookings open one month ahead, so the window for 27-29 Oct is already open; check availability now.
solo_ok: unverified (not stated); a 10-seat counter suits one
notes: JPY 540 otoshi. Cards OK. Reserve alternative: Sanchokuya Taka 産直屋 たか (Shinsen), 3.71 (548 reviews), Award Bronze 2017-20, Izakaya 百名店 2021-22 and EAST 2024-26, 12 counter seats, single start 19:15 Mon-Sat. Closed-days text says Sun and Mon, which conflicts with its hours list. Online booking only, but same-day phone bookings are accepted (090-6163-9708). The page said 'seats open on November 22 (Sunday)', so 26-30 Oct is probably full. https://tabelog.com/en/tokyo/A1303/A130301/13008327/

name: Sakai Shokai
station: Shibuya Sta. (3 min from exit C1, 357 m)
reservations: Online; phone line closed (050-1807-6914 listed). Rules not shown.
notes: The sake-led counter of the set, and open on Monday. Age 20+. Cards OK, no e-money or QR. Reserve alternative: Namikibashi Nakamura 並木橋なかむら, 3.62 (937 reviews), Izakaya 百名店 2021 and EAST 2024, Mon-Sat dinner. Booking moved to TableCheck from 13 Oct, and courses are required for 'foreign customers who may have difficulty communicating in Japanese'. https://tabelog.com/en/tokyo/A1303/A130301/13059986/

name: Uogashi Fukuchan 2 gou ten
name_ja: 魚がし 福ちゃん 2号店
station: Shibuya Sta. (1 min from Keio Inokashira west exit, 279 m)
closed: Saturday, Sunday and public holidays. Open Mon 26-Fri 30 (evenings only).
hours: Mon-Fri 16:00-21:30 (also listed as '16:00 until sold out')
notes: The highest-scoring tachinomi in the brief's area. Go early, since it sells out. Cash only (no cards, e-money or QR). Other tachinomi 百名店 2025 nearby scored lower: neo (Shinsen) 3.57, Nawa Noren (Ebisu) 3.53, Fujiya Honten (Shibuya) 3.52; see the Dropped list.

name: Tonkatsu Koko Made Yaru Ka.
name_ja: とんかつ ここまでやるか。
station: Gaiemmae Sta. (5 min from exit 1a, 285 m)
closed: Wednesday and Sunday (holidays included). CLOSED Wed 28. Open Mon 26, Tue 27, Thu 29 dinner and Fri 30 lunch.
reservations: Online; phone line closed (050-5593-0438). Lunch reservations let you skip the queue. Seat requests not guaranteed.
price_dinner: JPY 8,000-9,999 listed (reviews 6,000-7,999); the page doesn't say which band is dinner, so the split is inferred
notes: No cash (cards, iD/QUICPay, PayPay only). Fits a dinner or the Friday lunch. Reserve alternative: tonkatsu.jp Omotesando, 3.70 (993 reviews), Tonkatsu 百名店 2024 and 2026, 9 counter seats, Wed-Fri 11:30-15:30 and 17:30-21:00, closed Mon, Tue and the 1st or 2nd Wed, no lunch reservations. https://tabelog.com/en/tokyo/A1306/A130602/13264557/

name: Hayashi
station: Shibuya Sta. (2 min from Inokashira Line west exit; 360 m)
awards: Ramen TOKYO 百名店 2018-2025 every year (JP section also lists 2017)
closed: Wednesday, Sunday and public holidays. Open Fri 30 lunch.
hours: Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri/Sat 11:30-15:30, until sold out. Lunch only.
notes: Lunch-only pick for Fri 30. Queue before 11:30, since it closes when sold out. No cards, e-money or QR, so bring cash. The highest-scoring ramen in Shibuya and the area's only Tokyo ramen 百名店 2025 entry.

name: Chuka Menten Kiraku
station: Shinsen Sta. (355 m) / JR Shibuya Hachiko exit 8 min
closed: Wednesday. CLOSED Wed 28. Open Mon 26, Tue 27, Thu 29 and Fri 30.
notes: A Shibuya institution and an early or late fallback dinner. Last order 20:30, so not a late-night option. Cash only. Reserve alternative: Oyadori Chuka Soba Ayagawa Honten 親鶏中華そば 綾川 本店 (Ebisu), 3.75 (3,770 reviews), open year-round 11:00-21:30 until sold out, Suica accepted, only 2 counter seats, no 百名店 shown. https://tabelog.com/en/tokyo/A1303/A130302/13253970/

name: Tamawarai
station: Meiji-Jingumae Sta. (462 m, about 7 min); Harajuku or Shibuya about 10 min
awards: Tabelog Award Bronze 2019-2026 every year; Soba 百名店 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022, EAST 2024, 2025
closed: Monday, Tuesday and Sunday. CLOSED Mon 26 and Tue 27. Open Wed 28 and Thu 29 dinner and Fri 30 lunch, BUT the page warns of 'temporary closures for buckwheat harvesting in August, October and November' with no dates given. Confirm before going.
counter: counter available (count not shown); no private room
reservations: Online; phone line closed (03-5485-0025). Dinner is reservation-only. Weekday lunch is walk-in until the soba runs out (no Saturday lunch reservations). Reserved guests must order one dish besides soba.
price_dinner: JPY 10,000-14,999 listed (the page doesn't say which band is dinner, so the split is inferred)
notes: The best soba in the brief's area and a strong Friday lunch. Cash only. Trusted-foodie trace: Jason Wang (cityfoodsters) logged Tamawarai in Sep 2016 (per docs/research/food/15-critic-wells-wang.md; log link unverified per place). The October harvest closure is the main risk.

name: Udon Yamacho
station: Ebisu Sta. (3 min from JR west exit; Hibiya Line 4 min)
awards: Udon 百名店 TOKYO 2020, EAST 2022, EAST 2024
closed: No closing day shown; hours listed for every day including holidays. Open all our dates.
reservations: Online for dinner (phone line closed); no lunch reservations.
solo_ok: Yes: JPY 3,500 courses 'available even for just one person on the same day'
notes: A cheap, reliable dinner or Friday lunch that is open every day. Service fee may apply. Cards and PayPay OK. Trusted-foodie trace is ambiguous: Jason Wang's log lists a 'Yamacho (Jan 2026)' that may be this shop or the Tsukiji tamagoyaki shop, so unverified.
